Specialization.Name: Analyst (reSpecialized) 1.1
Specialization.Description: [H4]Analyst (Respec1.0)[h4] [B]ANALYST—CONSTANT BLUR OF SPINNING PLATES AND KNIVES[b][BR] [B]At a Glance[b][BR] The analyst is the military or diplomatic attache, capable of fulfilling a comms or technical officer, or being the “know-it-all” character for a more seasoned political type. They are the person who is always in the know, always capable of adding value to any situation through knowledge and insight.[BR] [B]All-in or Hybrid?[b][BR] 3/5 Knowledge as a Tool 1/10 Perception as “in the action” element 3/10 Computers as Communication Offense & Defense[BR] [B]What Should it be the Best At?[b][BR] Planning and Utilizing Knowledge as utility[BR] Technical Communications[BR] [B]What should it be just “good” at?[b][BR] Perception and noticing things[BR] Assisting social encounters[BR] [B]Specs for Comparison / Inspiration[b][BR] [I]Scholar[i](Both have a core in being “intelligence support," but while the Scholar only barely supplements their core niche, the Analyst has a sub-niche in Computers. Also, it has a decided use-case rather than generalized "knows things.”)[BR] [I]Strategist[i](Closest to the Analyst, they function in similar roles both in a party and in a military unit. The strategist obviously has the option to lead a battle if it comes up, but otherwise, they just know things).[BR] [I]Slicer[i](Barely any overlap, as the slicer is very focused on offensive and defensive slicing, and the underworld in general. Analyst is just all in on knowledge and it's particularly good at codebreaking and shielding intelligence). [B]Media Touchstones[b][BR] Kleia (Andor)[BR] EDI (Mass Effect 2&3)[BR] [I]updated 12/10/2025[i]
